findings.evidence: Rapidity.lean:117 concludes `v.timeComponent + a = √⟪v, v⟫ₘ * exp (v.rapidity n)`; the proof body (lines 118–123) is `exp_rapidity (by rwa [hpar])` plus `eq_sqrt_mul_mul_sqrt_div hA hB` with `hA : 0 ≤ v⁰ + a`, `hB : 0 < v⁰ - a`, i.e. the collinearity enters only through `minkowskiProduct_self_eq_mul_of_spatialPart_eq_smul` (MinkowskiProductExtensions.lean:56), which rewrites `⟪v,v⟫ₘ` into `(v⁰+a)(v⁰−a)`.
findings.fix: State the general form first, e.g. `theorem timeComponent_add_inner_spatialPart_eq_sqrt_mul_exp_rapidity {v n} (h : |⟪v.spatialPart, n⟫_ℝ| < v.timeComponent) : v.timeComponent + ⟪v.spatialPart, n⟫_ℝ = √(v.timeComponent ^ 2 - ⟪v.spatialPart, n⟫_ℝ ^ 2) * exp (v.rapidity n)` (and the `-`/cosh/sinh analogues), then derive the collinear `√⟪v,v⟫ₘ` versions with one `rw [minkowskiProduct_self_eq_mul_of_spatialPart_eq_smul hn hv, inner_spatialPart_eq_of_spatialPart_eq_smul hn hv]`.
findings.issue: `timeComponent_add_inner_spatialPart_eq_sqrt_mul_exp_rapidity` assumes `hn : ‖n‖ = 1` and `hv : v.spatialPart = a • n`, but those hypotheses only serve to rewrite `√((v⁰)² − v_∥²)` as `√⟪v,v⟫ₘ`. The identity itself (textbook `E + p_z = m_T e^{y}`) needs neither: under `|⟪v.spatialPart,n⟫| < v⁰` alone it is `exp_rapidity h` plus `eq_sqrt_mul_mul_sqrt_div`, the private lemma already in the file. As stated the API is unusable for any four-vector with a transverse component. Same problem at lines 128 (`timeComponent_sub_inner_spatialPart_eq_sqrt_mul_exp_neg_rapidity`), 141 (`timeComponent_eq_sqrt_mul_cosh_rapidity`) and 149 (`inner_spatialPart_eq_sqrt_mul_sinh_rapidity`).

findings.evidence: grep for `isReal_of_minkowskiProduct_self_eq_zero` returns only Basic.lean:21 (module docstring), Basic.lean:102 (the declaration) and InvariantMass.lean:40, 212, 223 (docstrings); no proof term mentions it.
findings.fix: Either use it — e.g. add `hγ : γ.virtuality = -⟪q, q⟫ₘ` and state/derive `γ.IsReal` alongside the invariant-mass result in `InvariantMass.lean`, as `minkowskiProduct_add_self_of_target_energyFraction` already does with `hγ` — or drop the declaration.
findings.issue: `PhotonKinematics.isReal_of_minkowskiProduct_self_eq_zero` is added to the public API but no proof in the PR applies it — it appears only inside docstrings. Correspondingly the theorems it is cited in (`minkowskiProduct_add_self_of_realPhoton_energyFraction`, `energyFraction_eq_exp_rapidity_mul_sub_div_sqrt`) never relate `γ.virtuality` to `q` and never conclude `γ.IsReal`, so the asserted realness stays prose.

summary: The four light-cone decomposition lemmas in Rapidity.lean are stated only for collinear four-vectors, although the identity holds for any `v` under `|v_∥| < v⁰` with the transverse mass `√((v⁰)² − v_∥²)` in place of `√⟪v,v⟫ₘ`; the collinear forms are then one-line corollaries. The new `isReal_of_minkowskiProduct_self_eq_zero` is used by no proof.
